candidates.title: Make Something Agents Want
candidates.evidence:
Hosted By
YC
Make Something Agents Want Hackathon
Saturday, October 17
San Francisco, CA
Capacity 225
About Event
Y Combinator’s motto has always been “make something people want.” It’s increasingly “make something agents want.”

Bot and agent traffic on the web now is greater than human traffic. If you’re running a dev tools company, ecommerce store, or even a website, you are increasingly thinking about building for agents.

Building for agents is different. Agent experience (AX) rather than user experience (UX). Headless MCPs, rather than UIs and APIs. Optimizing token spend rather than minimizing user time. Documentation made for agents rather than humans.

If you’re an exceptional builder who wants to create for the future of agents as the user, join us at the _Make Something Agents Want Hackathon_ hosted by YC teams building for agents.

Sponsors: [Armature](https://armature.tech/), [Blaxel](https://blaxel.ai/), [Inkbox](https://inkbox.ai/), [Insforge](https://insforge.dev/), [Manufact](https://manufact.com/), [Primitive](https://primitive.dev), [Stripe](https://stripe.com/), [Supabase](https://supabase.com/)

Schedule | October 17, 2026

 9 AM - Doors open and Sign In
 10 AM - Kickoff
 10:30 AM - Hacking Begins
 12:00 PM - Lunch
 12:15 PM - Lunch Lightning Talks
 5:00 PM - Dinner
 6:00 PM - Dinner Lightning Talks

October 18, 2026

 8:00 AM - Breakfast
 10:00 AM - Submissions Due + Live Demos
 11:00 AM - Judging Completes
 12:00 PM - Lunch
 12:15 PM - Winners Announced
 1:00 PM - Hackathon Ends

Prize Track:

Manufact: Best MCP Server for Agents

Best MCP server built for agents as the primary customer.

_Prizes_

1st: $3,000 cash, $6,000 Manufact credits
2nd: $1,000 cash, $3,000 Manufact credits
3rd: $500 cash, $300 Manufact credits

Judges: [Luigi Pederzani](mailto:luigi@manufact.com), Enrico Toniato, Andrew Khadder

Insforge: Agent-Native Cloud

1st: $1,000 cash (Visa giftcard) , $1,000 cloud credits

2nd: $500 cash (Visa giftcard) , $500 cloud credits

3rd: $300 cash (Visa giftcard) , $300 cloud credits

_Judges_:  [Tony Chang](mailto:tony.chang@insforge.dev) [Hang Huang](mailto:hang.huang@insforge.dev)

Armature: Best Agent Experience (AX):

Winner: $1,000 cash, $1,000 Armature credits

Runner-up: $500 cash, $500 Armature credits

Third: $300 cash, $300 Armature credits

Description: Agents can use your product through a dedicated Agent-Facing Interface (MCP, CLI). Build the best experience for them!

Judges: [Theodore Otzenberger](mailto:theodore@armature.tech), Louis Scremin

Best Agent Communication Setup with [Primitive.dev](http://Primitive.dev) 

Give your agent an identity.

Let it ask questions, receive replies, handle attachments & coordinate asynchronously.

Then show us what you built.

\_Cash Prizes:\_
1st: $3k 
2nd: $2k
3rd: $1k

Judges:

[Ethan Byrd](https://x.com/itsjustemail), [Ashley Ha](https://x.com/ashleybchae), [Ben Poile](https://x.com/_poile_)

Blaxel: Something a Human Would Never Want

_Coming shortly_

Inkbox 

_Interesting projects giving agents a persistent identity with email, phone, iMessage, and A2A, so they can communicate with humans and each other_

1st place: $1,000 in Inkbox credits

2nd place: $500 in Inkbox credits

3rd place: $200 in Inkbox credits

Stripe
_Build an agent that can safely participate in the economy: buy products, provision services, manage business spending, or pay for the resources it needs to complete a task. We’re looking for useful, creative, end-to-end experiences that give users clear control over what their agents can do and spend._

Prizes

 Stripe Atlas:
 All participants: [20% off ](https://dashboard.stripe.com/atlas/invite/tscmsezh)(shared before hackathon)
 1st, 2nd, 3rd place Winners: [Fee waived](https://dashboard.stripe.com/register/atlas?atlas_invite=se3u1wzs) (shared after hackathon)
 Stripe Credits:
 All participants: $500
 1st: $3k
 2nd: $2k
 3rd: $1k

Supabase

_Coming soon_
